mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_purchase_order (supplier_name, supplier_phone, unit_price, total_amount, purchase_date, expected_arrival_date, status, remark, is_deleted, created_by) VALUES (#{supplierName}, #{supplierPhone}, #{unitPrice}, #{totalAmount}, #{purchaseDate}, #{expectedArrivalDate}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{isDeleted}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT purchase_request_id FROM t_purchase_order_item WHERE purchase_order_id = #{orderId}

SELECT id, supplier_name, supplier_phone, unit_price, total_amount, purchase_date, expected_arrival_date, status, remark, is_deleted, created_by, created_at, updated_at FROM t_purchase_order WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE t_purchase_order SET supplier_name = #{supplierName}, supplier_phone = #{supplierPhone}, unit_price = #{unitPrice}, total_amount = #{totalAmount}, purchase_date = #{purchaseDate}, expected_arrival_date = #{expectedArrivalDate}, remark = #{remark} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_purchase_order SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_purchase_order SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t_purchase_order WHERE purchase_request_id = #{purchaseRequestId} AND is_deleted = 0)
